== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later [[DS-61-4 (Errata)|Errata]] / [[DS-61-4 (PC Errata)|PC Errata]] articles of this family. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0). Appendix A repeats that Glossary text and is not a PC Errata column. The 2017 E-slip, 2018 Holotable GIF, and 2023 D-E1 face are same-words remasters of the Glossary text, not extra columns. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, foil, or (V) articles. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
